'''Peter Gobel''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Fort Collins tournament]] on 21 April 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2234">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-ft-collins-co-4-21-01-niiiice-trd2234/ ft-collins-co-4-21-01-niiiice-tr], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 5 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-ft-collins-co-4-21-01-niiiice-trd2234/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
